message.content: Columbia University is a private Ivy League research university located in New York City, United States. It was founded in 1754 as King's College by royal charter of King George II of Great Britain, making it the fifth-oldest institution of higher education in the United States. The university is situated on the Morningside Heights campus in Manhattan, with additional campuses in the Bronx (the Columbia University Medical Center) and in Washington, D.C. (the Columbia Law School). Columbia offers undergraduate, graduate, and professional programs across a wide range of disciplines, including arts and humanities, social sciences, natural sciences, engineering, business, law, medicine, and public health. It is known for its rigorous academic standards, distinguished faculty, and significant contributions to research and scholarship.
